profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer @ JPMorgan Chase | Computer Science & Engineering
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer rooted as a creative. Known for problem-solving, reliable ownership, and fostering cross-team collaboration. Currently focused on sharpening AI literacy beyond prompting and catalyzing conversations that build community. Dedicated to continuous learning and creating impactful, customer-centric solutions.

positions.title: Prototype Developer
positions.description: Quickly build and iterate on a touch-screen app used for user testing and showcasing UI designs and animations

positions.title: Web and Digital Media Manager
positions.description:
• Worked with a global team to create content for digital media and marketing initiatives
• Managed public-facing websites for TowerJazz and TowerJazz Panasonic Semiconductor
• Improved SEO by adding HTML and open graph meta tags as well as alt tags and refactoring code to meet mobile-friendly standards
• Reported directly to the VP of Corporate Communications
• Set up a marketing automation platform to streamline processes and gain insight to make data-driven decisions

positions.title: Marketing Communications, Graphic Design
positions.description:
• Designed brochures, programs, banners, annual reports, ads, displays and anything else needed
• Worked with vendors to print and ship
• Restructure content and update the public facing website

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Intern
positions.description:
• Interned for Modernism and After, Object Design II: User Experience, and Exploring Materials
• Provided feedback in class critiques, taught and led discussions, tracked attendance and helped grade student assignments

positions.title: Photography and Design Internship
positions.description:
• Documented and wrote about forPEACE partners in Cambodia, Germany, and Israel
• Prepared informational documents for delegations
• Coded forPEACE’s first website
• Organized a fundraiser to build a home for a Cambodian family

positions.title: Athletic Creative Services Assistant Director
positions.description:
• Received several Citations of Excellence in Publications from CoSIDA
• Built and updated media-guide websites to reduce costs and simplify sharing info and stats
• Designed print graphics and built a website for the Men's Volleyball 2009 NCAA Tournament
• Assisted with interviews and candidate selection when hiring new designers
• Occasionally prepared and gave presentations
• Continued to work with Athletic Marketing, Media Relations, University Photography and Printing Services to brainstorm ideas, layout and design publications, assist at photo shoots and proof and print projects for assigned teams

projects.title: Localized
projects.description:
A family file-sharing app (React, Node, Express, Bookshelf, Knex, Postgres, Redis, S3)
• Configured uploading files to S3 via AWS’s Node SDK to streamline storage and retrieval of user content. 
• Automated generating video thumbnails using Node and FFmpeg for a more consistent media grid user interface
• Integrated 360 image-viewing with A-frame and logic to distinguish between a 360 and regular image

projects.title: MuseTrap
projects.description:
An app for beat making and sharing (React, Express, Mongoose, Mongo)
• Optimized front-end performance by converting audio files into Howler objects to minimize component re-rendering
• Used React Bootstrap and custom CSS to create a more intuitive interface and user experience
